Grab your FREE Central TX Relocation Guide and start planning your move with confidence:  🔗 https://bit.ly/3DWFw7V
----------
Buying a home in Central Texas? Don’t get surprised by property taxes in Texas! In this video, we break down Texas property taxes step by step so you can know exactly what you’ll pay each month. Learn how Texas property taxes are calculated (assessed value × local tax rate), why rates differ across Temple, Belton, Troy, Killeen, and Salado, and how these differences can add hundreds to your mortgage—even on homes with the same price.

We also explain what’s included in PITI (principal, interest, taxes, insurance, and mortgage insurance), how escrow accounts work, and why new construction homes often see a spike after the county reassesses from “land only” to full home value.

Whether you’re comparing neighborhoods or planning your first purchase in Central Texas, this guide gives you the insights you need to understand tax rates, assessed values, and your true monthly costs—so you can budget smarter and avoid surprises!
